slides.title:
Whose star
is it in?
slides.subtitle: Every graha works for a star lord

slides.label: Rule 11
slides.title: 27 stars, 9 lords
body: The Moon’s road is cut into 27 stars, the nakshatras. Each star has a lord, one of the nine grahas.
slides.closing: Three rounds of the same nine lords

slides.label: How to read it
slides.title: Three steps
items: Find the star the graha stands in
Read the graha through its lord and the house it sits in

slides.label: This week
slides.title:
The king works
for the auditor
body: The Sun stands in Anuradha, one of Saturn’s stars. Read the king through the auditor: bosses want patience and careful work.

slides.label: In its own star
slides.title:
Saturn answers
to Saturn
body: Saturn stands in Uttara Bhadrapada, one of its own stars, so it carries its own work.

slides.label: In your chart
slides.title:
Your birth star
starts your clock
body: The star your Moon was born in has a lord. That lord runs the first dasha of your life.

slides.label: In real life
slides.title: Like a job title
body: A sales manager still reports to someone. Whose star a graha stands in tells you who it reports to.
